scenes.narration: Bharat mein electric vehicle ki kranti ne puri duniya ko chaukaya hai, lekin kya yeh kranti sachmuch mein asardar hogi? Pichle paanch saalon mein desh mein EV ki bikri mein 300% se adhik ki vriddhi hui hai. Yeh badlaav kitna mahatvapoorn hai, yeh hum aage chal kar dekhenge.

Desh ki sabse badi car nirmaata company, Tata Motors ne apne portfolio mein EV ko shaamil kiya hai. Tata ki Nexon EV ne market mein sabse adhik bikri darj ki hai, lekin kya yeh desh ki sabse acchi EV hai?
Hyundai ne bhi apni Kona Electric ko launch kiya hai, jo ki ek bahut hi acchi EV hai. Iski range 452 kilometer hai, jo ki isse ek popular choice banati hai.
MG Motor ne bhi apni ZS EV ko launch kiya hai, jo ki ek bahut hi acchi EV hai. Iski range 340 kilometer hai, jo ki isse ek popular choice banati hai.
